{{short description|Japanese mathematician}}
{{nihongo|'''Kazuoki Azuma'''|吾妻 一興|Azuma Kazuoki|}} (born 1939)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://id.ndl.go.jp/auth/ndlna/00262877|title=吾妻, 一興, 1939-|work=Personal names|publisher=[[National Diet Library]]|access-date=2024-05-18}}</ref> is a Japanese [[mathematician]]. [[Azuma's inequality]] in [[probability theory]] is named after him.<ref name="KobayashiMark2011">{{cite book|last1=Kobayashi|first1=Hisashi|last2=Mark|first2=Brian L.|last3=Turin|first3=William|title=Probability, Random Processes, and Statistical Analysis: Applications to Communications, Signal Processing, Queueing Theory and Mathematical Finance|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=DQCMdT-3qbQC&pg=PA272|accessdate=26 June 2012|date=2011-11-01|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=9780521895446|pages=272–}}</ref>

==Publications==
* {{cite journal|last=Azuma|first=Kazuoki|year=1967|title=Weighted sums of certain dependent random variables|journal=Tohoku Mathematical Journal|volume=19|issue=3|pages=357–367|issn=0040-8735|doi=10.2748/tmj/1178243286|url=http://projecteuclid.org/DPubS/Repository/1.0/Disseminate?handle=euclid.tmj/1178243286&view=body&content-type=pdf_1|format=PDF|doi-access=free}}
